options.content:
## Run integrity
This page answers the first operational question: **did every expected answer reach Postgres and MLflow?** A run is complete only when its stage lifecycle says `completed` and recorded samples equal expected samples. Failed and still-running stages stay visible with their MLflow run ID and error.

panels.title: Run — lifecycle and sink evidence
panels.description: One row per approach. MLflow run IDs link the durable stage record to the answer rows shown by the other dashboards.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT run_id, approach, status, started_at, completed_at, requested_device, actual_device, runtime, weight_format, model_name, expected_samples, recorded_samples, expected_samples - recorded_samples AS missing_samples, mlflow_run_id, error
FROM evaluation_runs
WHERE run_id IS NOT NULL
  AND split_part(run_id, '_', 1) || '_' || split_part(run_id, '_', 2) = ${run:sqlstring}
ORDER BY run_id, approach

panels.title: Stages complete
panels.description: Completed stages whose recorded sample count exactly matches the expected count.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'completed' AND recorded_samples = expected_samples)::float / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS completion_ratio
FROM evaluation_runs
WHERE run_id IS NOT NULL
  AND split_part(run_id, '_', 1) || '_' || split_part(run_id, '_', 2) = ${run:sqlstring}

panels.title: Expected / recorded answers
panels.description: Counts across all stages in the selected run group.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT SUM(expected_samples) AS expected, SUM(recorded_samples) AS recorded
FROM evaluation_runs
WHERE run_id IS NOT NULL
  AND split_part(run_id, '_', 1) || '_' || split_part(run_id, '_', 2) = ${run:sqlstring}

panels.title: Failed or incomplete stages
panels.description: Must be zero before a run is trusted.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS unhealthy_stages
FROM evaluation_runs
WHERE run_id IS NOT NULL
  AND split_part(run_id, '_', 1) || '_' || split_part(run_id, '_', 2) = ${run:sqlstring}
  AND (status <> 'completed' OR recorded_samples <> expected_samples)

list.name: run
list.label: Run
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT split_part(run_id, '_', 1) || '_' || split_part(run_id, '_', 2) FROM evaluation_runs WHERE run_id IS NOT NULL ORDER BY 1 DESC
